title: Introduction
slide_intent: Explain why a shared identity matters to local programs. People encounter the organization through what programs do as well as through the materials they produce.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can strengthen recognition across programs while allowing each program to address its own community.
demonstration: A bold statement about reputation sits beside a narrower explanation of the guidelines. A lower montage places different programs’ publications, clothing and signs together.
practical_value: Use the introduction to distinguish the common reputation a communication supports from the local occasion it addresses.

content_islands.name: Introduction
content_islands.spec: Place the red heading above two columns. Give the definition of reputation heavier type than the scope note.

content_islands.name: Program materials
content_islands.spec: Arrange printed covers, small identity items, apparel and a tall banner as one montage across the lower page. Place a faint construction drawing behind the left side.
